mechanism: Tetrabenazine causes dopamine depletion and can worsen bisphosphonate-related side effects including potential CNS depression and orthostatic hypotension, while zoledronic acid may increase electrolyte disturbances affecting tetrabenazine metabolism.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression, dizziness, and orthostatic hypotension; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte monitoring, particularly during zoledronic acid infusion cycles.
